ids_properties.comment: FusionLab replay export of mast shot 30166 (EFIT reconstruction, campaign M9). An educational digital twin compared with MAST data - carries no forecast; nothing here is validated or predictive. Export-only: IMAS is never FusionLab's internal data spine (docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md). Catalog bookkeeping (useful/abort), per-series provenance labels, logbook meta and the series the dictionary has no home for are in the sibling fusionlab_annotations.json sidecar of the same download. Units converted once at the export edge (house MA, 1e20 m^-3, keV, MW, MJ -> A, m^-3, eV, W, J); vacuum_toroidal_field/b0's reference radius is not recorded by the archive and is left unset. Generated by FusionLab IMAS-shaped export (export-only; IMAS is never the internal data spine).
